source_snapshot.procedure: Test SPI connections between CPU QSPI1 and TPM.
source_snapshot.criteria: Devices can successfully communicate over SPI.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_SPI_CPU_and_TPM; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly requires physical QSPI1 capture or TPM-firmware handshake.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; held Pending for CPU/TPM/probe identity, non-mutating SPI transaction oracle, calibrated capture or equivalent diagnostic, TPM trust-state preservation and recovery.

old_problem: OS TPM enumeration cannot prove the physical CPU-QSPI1 link. Undefined probing and TPM commands could load the bus or mutate ownership, hierarchies, PCRs, NV, provisioning or firmware; no endpoint-bound electrical/protocol oracle was supplied.
disposition_reason: ED-09 assigns physical work to a qualified operator. A complete safe review-layer case can be parameterized around a signed non-mutating transaction and immutable TPM baseline: passively capture the named CPU/TPM exchange, or use a documented equivalent vendor diagnostic, and prove trust state unchanged. Exact board/probe/transaction values gate execution but need not keep the review Pending.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2165, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2166 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00053-V002 / 10e452dfd7183fdf was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind board/CPU/TPM identities and QSPI1 probe points, voltage, SPI mode, clock, chip-select, timing and a proven non-mutating command/response oracle.
Freeze TPM presence, health, ownership/hierarchies, PCR/NV/provisioning and firmware baseline before capture and compare afterward.
Qualified operator uses calibrated high-impedance passive instrumentation; a vendor diagnostic is equivalent only if its documented coverage proves the named QSPI1 exchange and is non-mutating.
Retain raw waveform/decoded frames or signed diagnostic, setup photos, endpoint logs and restored probe-free state.
No TPM clear, ownership/provisioning, PCR extension, NV write, firmware change, active drive, reset or automatic repeat is allowed.
No probe, TPM command, state change, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Manual CPU-QSPI1-to-TPM non-mutating functional, electrical and state-preservation validation
test_case.purpose: Prove physical CPU QSPI1 communication with the intended TPM using a target-bound non-mutating exchange while preserving all TPM trust and firmware state.
required_package: Board/CPU/TPM identities, QSPI1 schematic and approved probe map
Signed voltage, SPI mode, clock/chip-select, non-mutating command/response and timing oracle
Qualified operator and calibrated high-impedance instrument, or approved equivalent diagnostic
Safe procedure, secure artifacts, abort thresholds and vendor recovery
test_case.test_command: MANUAL ONLY; BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Capture the frozen TPM baseline, then a qualified operator passively captures the approved CPU-QSPI1/TPM non-mutating exchange or runs the explicitly equivalent vendor diagnostic. Retain complete raw/decoded evidence and prove the TPM security and firmware state is identical afterward.
test_case.expected_result: The exchange is unequivocally bound to the named CPU and TPM, meets all electrical/protocol/timing criteria, produces the approved response, and leaves TPM presence, health, ownership, hierarchies, PCR/NV/provisioning and firmware unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed oracle, endpoint-bound physical/equivalent evidence and zero unapproved TPM-state delta. FAIL on wrong target, malformed/missing response, electrical/timing breach, probe anomaly or any state change. Missing oracle/operator/instrument is runtime BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until identities, probe map, non-mutating oracle, immutable baseline and recovery are signed.
Qualified operator only; passive high-impedance measurement at approved points.
No TPM clear/provision/ownership/PCR/NV/firmware action, active drive, reset or auto-repeat.
Stop on trust-state delta, unknown transaction, signal anomaly, TPM/CPU fault or boot impact.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and board/CPU/TPM/QSPI1 identities
Instrument calibration/settings and setup photos, or diagnostic version/hash/coverage
Complete waveform and decoded chip-select/clock/command/response/timing, or equivalent signed output
Before/after TPM trust, health and firmware-state comparison
CPU/TPM/BMC/boot/security logs and restored probe-free state
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on probe, protocol or trust-state anomaly. Remove probes only under the approved procedure and use the vendor recovery that preserves trust evidence; never clear, reprovision, rewrite firmware or force reset/retry to obtain a pass.
